data.title: Fiscal Year List of Requests From States or Tribes for a Small Business Administration Disaster Declaration
data.abstract: This notice provides an updated list of requests received by the U.S. Small Business Administration to make a disaster declaration for a state, territory, or tribe. The published list complies with a directive in the explanatory statement of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, Public Law 119-75.
